messages:
ana: heads-up — onboarding lyra20b-int4 showing a reproducible numeric tokenization regression on currency/math prompts. quality drop in money-addition tasks. posting repro and logs.
miguel: run id? config?
ana: run lyra-canary-6223 config: quant=perchannel-int4 calibrator=mae+kl microbatch=300k max_new_tokens=160 prefetch=on kv=enabled
harper: sample prompt and outputs?
ana: prompt: "If you have $12.50 and receive $7.75 more what is the total?"
  int4: "$1.03" (garbage)
  fp32 baseline: "$20.25" (correct)
  note: int4 output starts with a leading token "\u201c1\u201d" instead of "20\u201d — looks like token boundary shifted.
ravi: that smells like tokenizer splitting numeric tokens differently; quantized logits amplifying small softmax differences. can you attach tokenization for the prompt?
ana: tokenization dump (tokens + offsets):
```
prompt_tokens: ["If"," you"," have"," $","12",".50"," and"," receive"," $","7",".75"," more"," what"," is"," the"," total","?" ]
int4_tokens_top: [["1", "20", "12"],[...]]
```
harper: aha — tokenizer produced separate tokens for integer and decimal parts in dev vocab, but onboarder earlier used a punctuation-normalized corpus. the discrepancy causes probability mass to split across tokens; quant rounding pushes mass to wrong token.
miguel: quick experiments: 1) try calibrator with explicit numeric-heavy corpus (banking/currency + math) 2) run layer-protect first/last layer fp16 to see sensitivity 3) test alternate tokenization normalization (join digits) in preprocessor as a stopgap.
nana: starting targeted calibrations: calib-numeric-6223 (2k numeric prompts) using kl+mse + per-channel. also standing up A/B: route 10% to tokenizer-join-digits preproc and 10% to layer-protect first1. infra-bot will create canary.
infra-bot: canary deploy started: lyra-canary-6223 -> nodes [gpu-g1-08,gpu-g1-09], routing: int4-base=80%, token-join=10%, layerprot-first1=10%, trace-sample=1% :rocket:

miguél: note — token-join preproc may affect generalization for non-numeric prompts, so keep traffic limited.
harper: also check kernel messages; some alignment fallbacks change token logits behavior across nodes. any kernel logs?
nana: yes saw this once in traces:
```
[2026-03-24T11:18:02Z] WARN kernel-selector: fallback to dot-small for block 3 due to alignment mismatch
```
ravi: kernel fallback could shuffle accumulation order; pin kernel images for canary nodes and re-run. infra?
infra-bot: pinning kernel on nodes: gpu-g1-08 -> matmul-v3, gpu-g1-09 -> matmul-v3. pin applied.

miguél: initial A/B quick results (30m):
- token-join preproc (10%): Currency exact-match 89.2
- layer-protect first1 (10%): Currency exact-match 86.4
- int4-base (80%): Currency exact-match 71.0
- fp32 baseline: Currency exact-match 92.1

harper: good — token-join gives strong lift. what's latency impact?
nana: token-join p50 +8ms, p95 +20ms. layer-protect p50 +12ms. both acceptable as triage.
miguel: longer-term we should: 1) include numeric normalization in calibration corpus and tokenizer tests, 2) add digit-join as optional preprocessing feature for currency/finance routes, 3) surface tokenizer boundary tests in onboarding checklist, 4) gate with a numeric-exact metric.
ravi: agree. As interim: enable token-join preproc for finance routes, finish per-channel+kl+mse calib and compare vs token-join. if calib recovers performance we can disable token-join; if not, keep token-join as a configurational option. also reduce default max_new_tokens for lyra int4 canary from 160 -> 120 while triaging to reduce long accumulation risk.
nana: done — patched route defaults: max_new_tokens=120 for lyra-canary-6223. infra-bot applied rolling restart.
infra-bot: route defaults patched, rolling restart initiated on canary nodes.
harper: add a small regression test: for every new model, run 500 numeric prompts across common tokenizers (orig, join-digits) and fail onboarding if numeric-exact drops >3 points vs fp32. put that in the PR checklist.
miguel: will open PR and add numeric prompts to calibration corpus. nana: will collect raw traces and token dumps and attach to the ticket. thanks all — will follow up with full calib results later.
